sources.title: Publication 946 (2025)
sources.support: Chapters 1, 3 and 4: correction route; acquired and placed in service after January 19, 2025; exclusions; GDS/ADS classes and MACRS methods. Read current version and relevant passages.

sources.title: Publication 925 (2025)
sources.support: Rental exceptions and material participation; basis, at-risk, passive and excess-business-loss limits. These do not determine the building recovery period.

sources.title: Publication 527 (2025)
sources.support: Land is not depreciable; allocation of land/building costs; personal-use dwelling limits.

sources.title: Publication 544 (2025)
sources.support: Structural components; adjusted basis, Sections 1245/1250 and disposition/recapture rules.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 3115 (12/2022)
sources.support: Part IV: negative 481(a) adjustment generally one year; current guidance and eligibility still must be checked.

sources.title: Publication 5653 (2-2025)
sources.support: Cover disclaimer, chapter 3.D (printed p32) no IRS preparation standards; chapters 4–5 documented classifications, cost support and basis reconciliation. Not study approval/audit-risk assurance.

sources.title: IRS audits
sources.support: Return selection and examination; does not support assurance that cost segregation cannot increase risk.

sources.title: 2025 Instructions for Form 4562
sources.support: Bonus date change and qualification/elections; review original property dates.

sources.title: Notice 2026-11
sources.support: Permanent 100% bonus eligibility and binding-contract/self-construction acquisition guidance.
